inspiration.observed_pattern: A MariaDB grouped query folds attribute rows into one JSON object per owning identifier with JSON_OBJECTAGG.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a service configuration history report over new rows. Duplicate property names test whether JSON_OBJECTAGG preserves repeated object members, while a NULL value and ordered service output exercise JSON aggregation edge semantics without copying source schema, values, or query text.

fixture_notes: Service 501 has two timeout history rows and one region row; service 502 has one NULL-valued enabled property. The complete JSON objects are selected so duplicate-member preservation, NULL encoding, and result metadata remain observable.
determinism_notes: Configuration IDs are fixed primary keys and services are ordered by their unique ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE service_config_values (config_id INT PRIMARY KEY, service_id INT NOT NULL, property_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, property_value VARCHAR(64) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT service_id, JSON_OBJECTAGG(property_name, property_value) AS settings FROM service_config_values GROUP BY service_id ORDER BY service_id

checks.sql: SELECT service_id, config_id FROM service_config_values ORDER BY service_id, config_id
